title: Qcqs internal direct image preserves bounded-below etale origin
statement: For a finite discrete commutative ring B, the realization F of [def-weil-pbc-common-finite-discrete-encoding], a qcqs scheme morphism h:S to T and K in the bounded-below etale derived category on S, the object R h_internal,* (F_S K) lies in the essential image of F_T. No pullback family, coherence equation or specified mate is mentioned.

proof.text: Apply the bounded-below finite-coefficient etale/pro-etale direct-image comparison. Its comparison isomorphism identifies the ordinary realization of R+ h_et,* K with R+ h_proet,* of the realized complex.

Apply the coefficient-conjugation interface to the bounded-below pro-etale direct image, then compose its isomorphism with the ordinary comparison after applying the target coefficient equivalence. The resulting witness is R+ h_et,* K.

proof_origin.note: Concrete Lean proof uses the existing ordinary comparison, bounded-below inclusion compatibility, and a separate coefficient-conjugation interface.
